notes.title: Bug fixes - 1.09
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug where hitting "Play Again" after losing a game would let you resume to your pre-lose state
- Fixed visual bug when resuming a save game in High Contrast mode with Locked Tiles

notes.title: Bug fixes - 1.08
notes.notes:
Hey! Here are this week's bug fixes


 Word Play now works with touchscreen Windows devices
 Modifier "If two adjacent tiles share the same letter, both score 3x" now works with Mirror Tiles
 Fixed issue with modifier "Add 10 Bonus Points during Special Rounds"
 Glass duplicates now duplicate the tile's upgraded score
 Improved updating issues with Mirror and Exclamation tiles
 Improved visual clarity of "Double the Bonus Points rewards for spelling longer words"
 "When you sell any other Modifier, add to your Play count instead of Refreshes" changed to Legendary rarity
 Improved visual clarity of special tiles in the Letter Bag, including when using high contrast accessibility mode
 Fixed bug with dragging a tile from the submission queue when using the Upgrade "Lock a tile for eight submissions. When it unlocks, permanently double its score"
 Clarified the Modifier "Add 5 Bonus Points for each unused Upgrade use"
 Clarified "S and Z can be used interchangeably" Modifier

notes.title: Bug fixes - 1.07
notes.notes:
Just a few today!


 Fixed bug with "Swap a tile with a common Consonant from the Letter Bag"
 Fixed bug with "If two adjacent tiles share the same letter, both score 3x"

notes.title: Bug fixes and balance changes
notes.notes:
Hi! Thanks for your continued Word Play bug reports. Here's what's changed in 1.06:

New:

Added more words to the Word Play dictionary

Added tutorial message if player clicks, but doesn't hold, on refresh button

Diamond Tiles are de-prioritised when typing on the keyboard

Re-balanced:

Buffed Modifier "Add 3 Bonus Points. Increases by 1 when you add a new tile to the Letter Bag". Now +2 on new tile.

Buffed "If two adjacent tiles share the same letter, both score double", to both score triple

Buffed I, E, and O, and Letter Pair challenges. Now +4, and lock at +40.

Buffed "Add 1 Bonus Points for each unused Upgrade" to be +5

Buffed "Increases by 2 whenever you re-roll the perks" Modifier, to +5

Certain Special Rounds (including Special Tiles Nullified) are less likely to appear

Fixed:

Fixed bug with "If the last word of the round starts with a Vowel, the perk screen will have four perks to pick from"

Improved "Alphabet Challenge" achievement experience

Improved interaction between ! and Mirror Tiles

Fixed bug with "Y is considered a vowel" and "The lowest-scoring Consonant scores 5x"

Improved clarity of "Swap a tile with a Vowel from the Letter Bag", if you don't have the "Y is a vowel" Modifier

Fixed bug with "Convert a tile into a Wildcard Tile with the same score" upgrade

Fixed visual bug when re-rolling perks while using lowercase accessibility setting

Fixed bug with Modifier "If the last tile is a Vowel, permanently increase its score by 2"

Fixed bug with Modifier "Double the Bonus Points rewards for spelling longer words"

Changed descriptions of Refresh and Hold Zone modifiers to increase clarity

Fixed issue with "After each submission, convert a random unsubmitted tile into a Diamond Tile" sometimes picking Diamond tiles

Improved controller support during Special Round "Can use up to 5 Tiles" (etc)

notes.title: Bug fixes - 1.05
notes.notes:
One last patch for the week! Thanks again for your bug reports


 If you have more than one modifier that lets you refresh for free, only one will be used up
 Fixed issue with adding phantom tiles to the letter bag when playing with a controller / Steamdeck
 Improved typing support when cycling through multiple letters
 Improved typing support for ING and ERS tiles - use Shift + I and Shift + E to input them
 Removed automatic typing support for wildcards (use 8 / * to insert manually), to reduce confusion
 Changed some random elements to favour player
 Fixed issue with saving and loading Special Round "Top 4 Tiles are Locked"
 Improved performance when using the Modifier "S and Z can be used interchangeably"
 Improved various interactions with mirror tiles, wildcard tiles, and exclamation tiles
 [strike]Diamond Tiles that are locked will now retain their progression when unlocked[/strike] - Sorry, this was broken! Will restore in a future patch


Thanks!

Mark

notes.title: Bug Fixes - 1.04
notes.notes:
Thanks for your bug reports!

New

Added labels in perk screen if you cannot choose a perk because you already have the maximum number of Modifiers / Upgrades

[strike]You can now navigate to the score bar with a controller, to show how many points are needed to finish the round (previously required a mouse)[/strike] (Coming soon, was broken!)

Added 150 petitioned words to the dictionary

Added symbol to Emerald tiles to help colourblind players differentiate from Golden tiles

Fixed

Changed Modifiers to not consider ! as a "letter", to avoid situations like "If First Letter is !"

Changed it so typing now prioritises Special Tiles, hold shift to prioritise Standard Tiles (flipped behaviour)

Fixed issue with "3 in 4 chance for the perk screen to have four perks to pick from" Modifier

Fixed issue with vowel corners and Special Round "First Tile is Locked"

Blocked the Special Round "Word Must Include Highlighted Tile or Lose 2 Plays" from picking a locked tile

Fixed issue with "If the word has three or more Special Tiles, duplicate and add them to the Letter Bag"

Fixed display issues with "Word does not use a Play if it has exactly 4 tiles. Length changes every time this Modifier triggers"

notes.title: Bug Fixes - 1.03
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the bug reports. I'm continuing to fix and improve the game - with a focus on show-stopping problems. Here's what I fixed in 1.03.

New

Added option on Steam Deck to show Mouse Cursor, if you prefer to play with a virtual mouse rather than touch (please use the system settings to change the joystick or trackpad to mouse emulation).

Keyboard shortcuts only appear when you start using the keyboard. They won't show if you're a mouse only player

Fixed

Fixed issue with resuming a save with "This Modifier shows the next four tiles to come out of the Letter Bag"

Fixed extremely rare crash related to giving random Upgrades

Fixed issue with resuming a save game and Modifiers/Special Rounds that highlight which tiles are vowels

Improved clarity on rules for Special Round "Can Submit Up to 4 Tiles"

Fixed issue with Modifier "+2 Bonus Points if the word is the same length as the previous word" not working with compound tiles

Fixed bug with "Tiles Refresh After Submission. Refreshes Cost Plays" Special Round and being able to get negative plays

Added explanation on certain Modifiers to state exactly which tiles count as Special Tiles

Fixed trigger issue with Modifier "If the word has exactly five tiles, the first and last tiles score 3x"

Fixed save and load issue with Modifier "You can Refresh for free. Works once per round"

Fixed issue with the game not using correct scores if you resume a save game while playing with a custom (non-English) Letter Bag

Fixed issue with "Swap a tile with a Vowel from the Letter Bag"

Fixed rare issue with tutorials and controls when playing with a controller

Changed rarities on "Return First Tile to Grid", "Return Last Tile to Grid" and "If another Modifier is Sold or Destroyed, make a copy" Perks

Changed description of a wildcard, to better explain how it operates and reduce ambiguity

Removed a slur from the dictionary

Fixed an issue with the Modifier "If the word contains a number from ONE to TWENTY, increase this Modifier by that many points"

notes.title: Bug Fixes - 1.02
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing Word Play, and thanks for your bug reports on Discord.

This patch is focused on fixing some of the more critical errors, including a few game breaking bugs.

- Fixed "Fill all the additional tile slots on the board, for the first word of each round" not working when resuming save game

- Fixed "Fill any unused Upgrade slots with random Common Upgrades" not working when resuming save game

- Fixed problems with "S and Z can be used interchangeably"

- Fixed problems with "Any word can start with RE"

- Fixed problems with + tiles and wildcards in the same word

- Fixed controller issue: you can now quickly drag a tile onto an upgrade card by pressing right trigger

- Fixed issue with "Swap a tile with a Vowel from the Letter Bag" and "Y is always considered a Vowel"

- Fixed issue with "If the word has at least three different Vowels, multiply the Final Score by 2" and "Y is always considered a Vowel"

- Fixed issue with "If you run out of Plays, get five more and keep playing" and the Special Round "Submit the highlighted tile or lose 2 Plays"

- Fixed crash if you destroy all of your tiles

- Fixed visual issue with pressing return too quickly while typing

Cheers! More to come in the coming days.

notes.title: Hotfix: Locked Tiles Bug
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Thanks so much for playing Word Play. The launch has been amazing!

I am currently working through your bug reports and feature requests. I hope to have a proper patch available soon but wanted to put out a quick hot fix to solve a problem where...

If you have the Modifier "All tiles are automatically Refreshed at the start of each round" and then enter the Special Round "The Top 4 Tiles Are Locked for 4 Submissions", it would create a very strange bug.

This was quite a common occurrence and caused a big issue, but was thankfully fixed by changing a single line of code! 

Thanks again - I'll get to work on the other issues!

Mark

notes.title: What's in the full version?
notes.notes:
Hey! Thanks so much for checking out the Word Play demo.

As you can imagine, the demo only gives you a small sample of what the full game will contain. So here's a rundown of what to expect in the full release when it launches next month.

More Special Tiles

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595259/518df27d62b1a7b7d99a887c83909e0e12884d76.png"]

You've gotten to play with Golden Tiles in the demo, but the full game features a bunch of other upgraded tiles too.

Like Dot Tiles, which double the word's score if used as the final tile. And Diamond Tiles, which power up every time you don't use them. There are others to discover!

More Perks

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595259/d19cbd9079d8a01925160cbec4d4380198f4e57b.png"]

The demo features just 27 perks (that means the modifiers, upgrades, and gifts you can grab when finishing a round). But the full game has over 100 of them!

Want to hold on to some tiles when refreshing? That's a perk. Want a tile that can mirror the letter to its left? That's a perk. Want to permanently destroy tiles? That's a perk!

These perks will change the way you play, open up new strategies and synergies, and create almost infinite replayability.

More Special Rounds

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595259/bc1accbd6b2982258a4687f83cbc64bbafcbd066.png"]

The demo has a few special rounds which force you to play in a specific way - like "Words Shorter Than Six Tiles Score 0 Points" and "Tiles Refresh After Submission".

The full game will have even more devious special rounds to test your spelling skills, and scupper your high score plans!

More Modes

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595259/a620dbcb7ca0351de437c94a787a680c6fc3760b.png"]

The demo gives you access to Word Play's easiest and most basic mode. The full game has a slew of more difficult modes to play (just try and beat Legendary mode!), plus a daily challenge, and more.

More Music

The amazing composer Zach Jones (who did the music for Mind Over Magnet) has composed a brilliant soundtrack for this game. You can hear a couple tracks in the demo but the full score will be heard in the final game.

More More!

The full game will also have Steam achievements, Steam Cloud support, and more quality of life and accessibility features.

There will also be more words in the dictionary. If you spell a word that's not in the Word Play dictionary, you can hit a button in game to petition for me to add it. I've already implemented some of the words you've suggested, including ZOOMER, OUIJA, VAPE, EMOJI, and WIFI. More will be added before the final release!

But When?!

Word Play will be released in July. If you add the game to your wishlist you'll get an email when the game goes live - and you can also take advantage of the launch week discount. But you should also subscribe to Game Maker's Toolkit on YouTube - I'll release a video when the game is released.

Future Plans

Don't worry - I've heard your requests for translated / localised versions of Word Play. I'd love to support this but as a solo developer I have to focus exclusively on the English version for launch. After that - I'll see what I can do. Even if it's just helping people mod additional dictionaries into the game.

And I've also heard your requests for a mobile version! And I totally agree - that's why Word Play will be released on iOS later this year, and Android sometime after that. As for consoles (it sure would be nice on that Switch 2 screen...), we'll have to wait and see.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo 1.04
notes.notes:
Hello! I've just applied the final patch for the demo, ahead of Next Fest on Monday. So here's what is new and fixed.

New


 You can now open the letter bag and peek at the game board while the shop is open, using two new buttons.
 Options menu lets you change volume settings from the title screen


Fixed


 You can now input "ing" tiles with the keyboard, by using the I key.
 Volume and music sliders now save properly
 Various other fixes


That's the final update to the demo, outside of perhaps a few invisible bug fixes if anything major gets dredged up during Next Fest. Otherwise... I better finish up the actual game!

As always, if you'd like to report a bug or suggest a feature, please visit the GMTK Discord where we have a few forum rooms for Word Play.

Mark

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo 1.03
notes.notes:
Hello! I've just applied a quick patch to the demo, mostly with bug fixes. So here's what's what:

New


 You can now revert a glass tile after making one. Drag and drop the glass tile back onto the upgrade card to smash it and start again


Fixed


 Holding the shuffle button to sort the tiles alphabetically now works on controllers and keyboards, too
 Various other fixes


Also - because this update made some under the hood changes to the codebase, save games from previous builds won't work and so they have been ruthlessly and carelessly deleted. Sorry! 

If you'd like to report a bug or suggest a feature, please visit the GMTK Discord where we have a few forum rooms for Word Play.

Thanks so much for word playing! 

Mark

notes.notes:
Patch Notes - Demo 1.02

New


 If you spell a word that's not in the Word Play dictionary, you can petition for its future inclusion from the options menu
 You can now spell words longer than 10 tiles. Just keep adding tiles to reveal a secret second set of submission slots!
 Added volume sliders for music and sound effects
 The title screen now shares some helpful tips for advanced options
 You can now click and hold the shuffle button to sort the letters alphabetically
  "+4 Refresh" gift now shows you how many refreshes you currently have
 "Covert All [X] Tiles to Golden Tiles" gift now shows you how many tiles you have with that letter


Fixed


 The "Preview upcoming letters" modifier now shows the "Ing" tile correctly
 Fixed an issue with glass tiles and the Midas Touch modifier
 Using a controller / keyboard to re-order the modifiers no longer makes the entire game explode


If you'd like to report a bug or suggest a feature, please visit the GMTK Discord where we have a few forum rooms for Word Play.

Thanks so much for word playing! 

Mark
